The Ultimate Detail Wash

An automatic wash runs you about $10, and leaves water spots, cheap acid soaps that strip your wax, and brushes full of the last car’s dirt dragged across your paint. We take the washing process further. Here’s exactly what the Ultimate Detail Wash includes:

  • Pre-wash, hand wash, and drying of the vehicle
  • Removal of bugs and bird droppings
  • Wheel, tire, and gas cap cleaning
  • Complete drying of the exterior, into the nooks and crannies
  • Streak-free exterior glass and windows
  • High-quality spray wax, 1 to 2 month durability depending on storage
Book the Ultimate Wash

We use pH-neutral soaps that leave a shiny, spot-free finish. P.S. It looks great in the rain, send us photos.

Our story

When work hours were shortened during the pandemic, A Couple Touches Detailing began its journey in July of 2021. We are a female-owned company that takes car care very personal.

We work with our customers one-on-one to find exactly what works best for them. We start with the customer’s auto detailing needs and work backwards, because after spending $50,000 on a vehicle, watching it slowly degrade just because upkeep is inconvenient never made sense to us.

And honestly: if you’re looking for a cheap and fast option to get your car detailed in Greenwood, we most likely won’t be a great fit. We take the washing process further and pay attention to every detail, treating your vehicle like our own.

All it takes is a couple touches, and your ride is looking like new again.

Frequently asked questions

We can’t guarantee that 100% of your dog’s hair will come out, pet hair works deep into interior fabrics. But up to 99.5% of the pet hair will be removed, and when we’re done you won’t see any. The extent of removal is thorough enough that a stranger wouldn’t be able to tell there had been pet hair in the vehicle to begin with.

Yes, we’d appreciate it if you removed any personal items from your vehicle, including the trunk. That lets us start detailing as soon as we reach your location. Leaving trash and loose items is completely fine, we’ll take care of the trash for you.

Due to safety reasons we do not remove seats from the interior. We have the proper tools to get the job done accurately without removing them.

Pet hair sticks to anything made of fabric, so covers or blankets over the seats help keep hair off. When hair builds up on the blanket, just take it off and throw it in the washer. Many customers also join the maintenance subscription so we keep it up on a monthly or bi-weekly basis.

You sure can. Just let us know how often you want the service done to your vehicle, and we’ve got you covered.
